name: Marginalia
tagline: The interesting things at the edges.
description: A personal identity for a research and writing studio. Expressive brackets, lilac notes, and an elegant reading serif turn annotations into the star of the system.
heading: instrument-serif
rules: Brackets frame a thought without closing it in.
Use a deliberately wide margin for notes and secondary commentary.
Keep long reading text on manuscript white, with lilac as an annotation field.

system.concept: Hand-annotated page objects, expressive bracket geometry, faint writing rules, and large literary serifs. The margins become a purposeful second voice.
headline: There is more
in the margins.
system.productNote: A little closer to the interesting parts.
features: Thoughtful research that starts with a closer look.
Writing that gives an interesting idea a clear place to live.
A practice that values the question as much as the conclusion.
system.layoutNote: Manuscript hero with a lilac annotation rail and expressive serif type. Brackets frame selected ideas; a real wide margin holds secondary notes.
